auth.setup.closed.text: The app is already set up. Sign in instead.
auth.setup.closed.description: Error shown when setup is submitted after an account already exists, for example by two people at once.

auth.setup.intro.text: Create the first account. It will be the administrator of the app.

auth.setup.submit.description: Button that submits the setup form and creates the administrator account.

auth.setup.title.description: Heading and page title of the first-run setup page, where the first administrator account is created.

auth.sign_in.invalid.description: Error shown on the sign-in page when the username or the password is wrong; it never says which.

auth.sign_in.locked.text: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
auth.sign_in.locked.description: Error shown on the sign-in page while the account or device is locked after repeated failed attempts. {minutes} is the whole number of minutes until the lock ends.

auth.sign_in.submit.description: Button that submits the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.title.description: Heading and page title of the sign-in page.

auth.sign_out.description: Button that ends the current session.

errors.not_allowed.text: You're not allowed to see this page.
errors.not_allowed.description: Heading and page title shown when the user may not open a page or the record doesn't exist; it never says which.

errors.page_not_found.description: Heading and page title shown when the address doesn't match any page of the app.

errors.unexpected.text: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unexpected.description: Heading and page title shown when an unexpected error stops a page from loading.

household.action.archive.description: Button that archives a member type or a member.

household.action.cancel.description: Button that closes a confirmation without doing anything.

household.action.delete.description: Button that deletes a member type or a member that was never used.

household.action.unarchive.description: Button that brings back an archived member type or member.

household.base_class.adult.description: Base class of a member type: an adult member of the household. Shown in lists and in the base class selector.

household.base_class.dependent.description: Base class of a member type: a person the household supports who is not a minor, such as an elderly relative. Shown in lists and in the base class selector.

household.base_class.invalid.description: Error under the base class field of a member type when no valid base class is chosen.

household.base_class.minor.description: Base class of a member type: a child under legal age. Shown in lists and in the base class selector.

household.confirm.archive_type.text: Archive the member type "{name}"? It won't be offered for members any more; members who have it keep it.
household.confirm.archive_type.description: Confirmation before archiving a member type; {name} is the type's name as entered.

household.confirm.delete_type.text: Delete the member type "{name}"? This can't be undone.
household.confirm.delete_type.description: Confirmation before deleting a member type that no member has; {name} is the type's name as entered.

household.field.base_class.description: Label of the base class selector of a member type.

household.field.name.description: Label of the name field for the household, a member type or a member.

household.id.conflict.text: Something different was already saved from this form. Reload the page and try again.
household.id.conflict.description: Error shown when a form is submitted again with different content after it was already saved once.

household.id.invalid.text: This form is out of date. Reload the page and try again.
household.id.invalid.description: Error shown when a form arrives without a valid identifier, usually because the page is very old.

household.member_type.base_class_in_use.text: Members have this type, so its base class can't change.
household.member_type.base_class_in_use.description: Error shown when an administrator tries to change the base class of a member type that a member has, even an archived member.

household.member_type.in_use.text: Members have this type, so it can't be deleted. Archive it instead.
household.member_type.in_use.description: Error shown when an administrator tries to delete a member type that a member has.

household.member_types.archived.description: Label next to a member type that is archived and no longer offered for members.

household.member_types.base_class_locked.text: Members have this type, so the base class is fixed.
household.member_types.base_class_locked.description: Note under the disabled base class selector of a member type that is in use.

household.member_types.create.description: Button that creates a member type.

household.member_types.empty.text: There are no member types yet. Create the first one below.
household.member_types.empty.description: Shown on the member types page while the catalog is empty.

household.member_types.intro.text: Name the kinds of members your household has, such as "Son" or "Grandmother". Each type has a base class, which decides how its members are treated.
household.member_types.intro.description: Introduction on the member types page; the names in quotes are examples.

household.member_types.member_count.description: Number of active members that have a member type, shown next to the type.

household.member_types.new.description: Heading of the form that creates a member type.

household.member_types.save.description: Button that saves the changes to one member type in the list.

household.member_types.title.description: Heading and page title of the member types page, and the link to it on the settings page.

household.name.control_characters.text: Remove the invisible control characters from the name.
household.name.control_characters.description: Error under a name field when the text contains invisible control characters, usually from pasting.

household.name.empty.description: Error under a household, member type or member name field when it is empty after removing spaces.

household.name.taken.text: That name is already in use.
household.name.taken.description: Error shown when another member type, or another member, already has the same name, ignoring upper and lower case.

household.name.too_long.description: Error under a household, member type or member name field when the name is longer than 64 characters.

household.settings.intro.text: The name of the household, as every member sees it.
household.settings.intro.description: Introduction on the household settings page.

household.settings.save.description: Button that saves the household name.

household.settings.saved.description: Confirmation shown after the household name is saved.

household.settings.title.description: Heading and page title of the household settings page, and the link to it on the settings page.

household.unnamed.description: Shown instead of the household name while no administrator has named the household.

offline.message.text: Reconnect to the internet to continue.

offline.title.description: Heading and page title of the page shown when the app is opened without a network connection.

settings.sections.description: Heading of the list of links to the household settings pages on the settings page.

settings.title.description: Heading and page title of the administrators' settings page.

settings.version.description: Line on the settings page showing the installed app version; {version} is a version number such as 0.1.0.

shell.home.title.description: Heading of the home page shown after signing in.

shell.nav.home.description: Navigation link to the home page.

shell.nav.label.description: Accessible name of the main navigation, read by screen readers as "Main navigation".

shell.nav.settings.description: Navigation link to the administrators' settings page.

shell.skip_to_content.description: Link at the very top of every signed-in page, visible when focused with the keyboard, that jumps past the navigation.

shell.user_menu.profile.description: Link in the user menu to the user's own profile page.

users.display_name.control_characters.text: The name contains characters that are not allowed.
users.display_name.control_characters.description: Error under the display name field when it contains invisible control characters.

users.display_name.empty.description: Error under the display name field when it is empty.

users.display_name.too_long.description: Error under the display name field when it is longer than 64 characters.

users.field.display_name.description: Label of the field for the name shown to other household members.

users.field.language.description: Label of the language selector on the profile page.

users.field.time_zone.description: Label of the time zone selector on the profile page.

users.field.username.description: Label of the username field, used to sign in.

users.locale.not_installed.text: Choose one of the available languages.
users.locale.not_installed.description: Error under the language field when the chosen language is not installed.

users.password.length.description: Error under the password field when the password is too short or too long.

users.profile.browser_default.description: First option of the language selector: follow the language of the browser in use.

users.profile.intro.text: Your language and time zone apply on every device you sign in from.

users.profile.save.description: Button that saves the profile settings.

users.profile.title.description: Heading and page title of the user's own profile page.

users.time_zone.invalid.description: Error under the time zone field when the value is not a known time zone.

users.username.invalid.text: Use 3 to 32 characters: lowercase letters a-z, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.
users.username.invalid.description: Error under the username field when it breaks the username rules.

users.username.taken.text: That username is already in use.
users.username.taken.description: Error under the username field when another account already has it.

validation.invalid.description: Generic error under a form field whose value is not valid.
